claim: In the matching retail DLL, two static Menu_SoundManager stop wrappers are exact 15-byte bodies that select one AudioSrcInfo from static audioSrcInfo (0x040086EB) and call already-canonical FACT-0125 AudioSrcInfo.Stop (0x060052C4). StopCheerVoice_Loop (0x060052AE), raw MethodDef row 782e3200000096007d610a00e3a500003d3d, RVA 0x00322E78, signature blob 000001, has code SHA-256 bd09c857a08a9f181430706d332d7fc7b542cbc2ab2f270573532874cfc8f92c; it loads audioSrcInfo[raw 7], stores the selected AudioSrcInfo in local0, calls Stop at IL+0x0009, and returns. StopSE (0x060052B5), raw MethodDef row a830320000009600e5610a00dbe40200423d, RVA 0x003230A8, signature blob 00010111aa20, takes one AudioSrcEnum parameter named slot and has code SHA-256 71081b697f7337a53855cbe29050aca01c20cb62f8efbd862eeb4772aa565100; it loads audioSrcInfo[slot], stores the selected AudioSrcInfo in local0, calls Stop at IL+0x0009, and returns. Both use fat method headers with maxstack 2 and local signature token 0x1100120B. Inbound callers remain separate gates.

Witness canonical/witnesses/CAP-R6-001/menu_sound_stop_wrappers.summary.json; prover tools/prove_menu_sound_stop_wrappers.py
evidence.observation: Exact matching-DLL two-method AudioSrcInfo.Stop wrapper family.
